title: Costlier new phones drive demand for refurbished devices in India: Report
description: India's refurbished smartphone market is growing as new devices get costlier, with Counterpoint Research reporting a 13 per cent rise in volumes in the first half of this year

title: 1 in 5 smartphones sold in India is refurbished: Counterpoint Research
description: Experts also point out that many feature phone users looking to buy their first smartphone prefer a more feature-loaded 4G phone rather than a basic new smartphone at the same price

title: Rising cost fuels rush for refurbished devices
description:
NEW DELHI: India's refurbished smartphones and
laptops market is set to significantly outperform the
market for new devices this year as soaring memory
costs push up prices and drive more consumers
towards certified pre-owned alternatives. The trend is
also prompting leading brands to strengthen their
official refurbished programmes, signalling that the
secondary market is becoming increasingly
mainstream.

title: India Refurbished Smartphone Volumes Grew 13% YoY in H1 2026 as Rising Component Costs Boost Demand
description: India’s refurbished smartphone volumes grew 13% YoY in H1 2026, even as new smartphone volumes declined by around 11% YoY, according to Counterpoint Research’s latest Global Pre-Owned Smartphone Market Report, H1 2026. India’s refurbished smartphone market continued to gain momentum in the first half of 2026 as consumers faced higher prices for new devices and increasingly looked for affordable ways to access premium smartphones.
